messages:
Jules: quick sweep — onboarding `tidal-3b-open` into model catalog. Owners: Maya (curation), Raj (perf), Olivia (infra). Need: licensing signoff, perf profile for 1k/4k token mixes, and an infra canary + quantization check. Any blockers? :eyes:
Maya: noted. I pulled the repo + weights link, adding metadata now. small question — the model card lists dataset attribution but license field is `CC-BY-NC-4.0`, can that be hosted in hosted catalog?
legal-bot: automated check -> flagged: `CC-BY-NC-4.0` = non-commercial restriction. Hosting on Redwood Hosted API would violate licensing unless we obtain explicit commercial grant. Suggested options: request relicense, host on Private/Dedicated only, or include as external reference with customer-hosting only.
Raj: perf smoke ran on a2-small (dev cluster) — throughput looks fine for short seqs but tail latency spikes at 2k+. snippet of the failing run:
```
seq_len=2048, batch=1 -> p99=880ms (expected ~400ms)
stack: large attention matrix alloc -> OOM-ish fallback to CPU in last stage
```
Raj: looks like KV cache growth + attention kernel isn't hitting the fused path for this arch. I'll bisect model config and run on a100 next.
Olivia: infra note — I need the exact checkpoint path + quantization recipe. If licensing forces Private-only, I can schedule a Private canary in the staging VPC this week. Also need the model-size tag (fp16/8bit) to provision GPU pools.
Maya: checkpoint is at s3://redwood-models/tidal/3b-open/v1/checkpoint.pt. The upstream distributed weights include a `noncommercial_notice.md` (hence the NC license). I can reach out to the maintainer to ask about relicensing but will take time.
Jules: thanks. actioning: (1) Raj — run perf on a100 + try q8_0 quant profile, share perf gist by EOD. (2) Maya — PR to update model metadata to include license flag and `hosted_allowed:false`, and start relicensing ask thread with contact. (3) Olivia — prepare Private canary runbook and estimate (GPU hours) in the canary doc. (4) Legal-bot / Legal — please escalate relicensing ask if possible.
Raj: will run a100 perf now, ping once I have numbers.
Maya: creating PR and opening an internal ticket ML-4128 for relicensing outreach. I'll link it: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/ML-4128
Olivia: adding canary steps to infra playbook, will include required instance types + quantization smoke steps. ETA tomorrow morning.
Jules: perfect. if relicensing fails, fallback plan: (A) add `tidal-3b-open` as Private-only model with clear UI restriction, (B) offer a hosted-compatible alternative (`tidal-3b-ll`) if maintainers provide a commercial fork. I'll follow up in ML-4128. :thumbsup:
